title: Prepare immutable FULL-T6 downstream Teamspace Drive package

acceptance.text: The final local FULL-T6 46D authority, row manifest, Temporal-v2 binding, and source hashes are verified without mutation or training.
The existing remote R128 RGB cache and index are resolved and referenced; no second RGB upload occurs.
Only final non-RGB FULL-T6 46D and required authority artifacts are uploaded to one new immutable Teamspace Drive directory with verified byte sizes.
RGB and 46D target IDs, T6 membership, labels, splits, masks, and ordering are cross-bound and pass locally.
A minimal durable storage invariant records local construction, Drive reuse, and Studio compute-only boundaries.

risks: The current R128 session is owner-protected and must not be touched.
Remote Drive APIs may expose sizes but not SHA256; hash status must remain pending when unavailable.
A stale or revoked authority must never be uploaded or referenced as predictive semantics.
non_actions: Do not start, stop, sleep, switch, or SSH into any Studio.
Do not train, benchmark, or run GPU code.
Do not upload or rebuild the existing RGB cache.
Do not upload raw videos, loose crops, source images, .git, .codex artifacts, or old/quarantined bundles.
Do not upload d890 or the invalid zero-mask artifact.
Do not modify the independent current R128 run or its open files.

skills.purpose: Verify exact FULL-T6 membership, split, labels, frame order, masks, and RGB/46D parity.
Hash-bind local sources, remote package files, authority identities, and immutable map references.
Keep downstream packaging separate from the independent RGB-only R128 experiment.
Preserve native target, split, and coverage semantics without running metrics or training.
Keep remote mutation bounded, observable, and fail-closed without lifecycle side effects.
Maintain isolated ownership, evidence, and closeout while preserving other dirty worktrees.

steps.summary: Verify final local authority, exact source paths and hashes, and RGB cache reuse binding.
Create one local upload manifest and upload only non-RGB final FULL-T6 artifacts to a new Drive prefix.
Verify remote sizes/hashes where exposed, complete local RGB/46D cross-binding, and write the data input map.
Record the minimal storage invariant and close with preserved R128 isolation and evidence.
